static_traits.name: Wang Hao
static_traits.family_status: The youngest child in the family
static_traits.social_status: Has interpersonal support(has a close friend),but Self-doubt makes it hard to start new relationships;self-esteem issues affect interpersonal and Work performance
static_traits.medical_history: Past experiences of low self-esteem and powerlessness when facing challenges;has not yet received psychotherapy;no significant physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Neutral attitude;expresses fairly clearly,able to distinguish logic from emotion;fairly cooperative with the counselor

basic_info.main_problem: I feel I will never be smart,because I failed when trying Learning new things,which led to powerlessness and Self-doubt.
basic_info.core_demands: This powerlessness is hindering me from pursuing new opportunities and affecting my self-esteem,so I decided to seek counseling.
growth_experiences: Repeated experiences of low self-esteem and powerlessness when facing challenges in the past,but never received counseling or therapy;no significant physical illness.
Grew up as The youngest child in the family,a role that may affect self-worth and Self-efficacy in long-term interpersonal and self-evaluation(the original only provides identity background).

special_situations.event: After failing at trying Learning a new skill
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I fail when Learning new things,it proves I am not smart and will never learn
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Endures alone, tries to force learning forward, and suppresses emotions

special_situations.event: Each time eating pizza or other high-calorie food
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Eating unhealthy food will inevitably cause serious illness and painful consequences
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Strictly controlling diet, spending large amounts of time online researching diabetes prevention, avoiding social occasions involving food
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will get diabetes and suffer Death because I cannot afford insulin

special_situations.event: When facing new challenges or trying to learn new content
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot master new content quickly,it means I am not smart enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Pushing through tasks with high Anxiety while constantly doubting oneself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will surely fail,I am not smart enough

special_situations.event: When performance declines at Work or in life,and attention is not focused
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One poor performance means my overall ability is inadequate
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Self-criticism,worsening Self-doubt,trying to 'correct' through stricter self-demands
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not capable in any aspect

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be seen as smart and capable, and to gain a stable sense of self-worth and security
core_conflict.fear: Fear that failure will prove powerlessness,or that one's own choices will cause disaster(such as illness and painful Death),leading to being negated and losing control
defense_goal: Reducing Anxiety and avoiding failure or disaster through control and avoidance(controlling diet,researching prevention,avoiding food-related socializing),and rational Interpretation

object_relations.self_representation: A self not smart enough and prone to failure
object_relations.object_representation: Others are potential judges(who may negate me in new challenges and social situations)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor suggests viewing dietary risks from a more balanced perspective or reducing excessive checking of information
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Subconsciously believing 'only continuous research and strict control are safe',understanding advice as not taking risks seriously enough
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Listing data and risks in a rational,calm tone,emphasizing prevention details,avoiding direct expression of feelings about 'Fear and uncertainty' as much as possible.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to Social gatherings involving high-calorie foods
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing others will force me to eat unhealthy food or not understand my worries(attributing one's own unease to others)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Speaks in a tense tone with strong defensiveness, emphasizing 'they will make me lose control', using others' motives as a reason for avoidance.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When facing new learning tasks or challenges, or experiencing one failure
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Categorizes situations and self-ability wholesale into the two poles of 'good/bad' and 'smart/stupid'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use absolute terms(such as 'forever''certainly''completely'),hurried tone,insisting on binary conclusions,excluding middle ground and complexity.

manifestations: Strongly associating eating pizza or high-calorie foods with getting diabetes and suffering Death from being unable to afford insulin
Repeatedly thinking about the 'worst outcome' for health and life, unable to shake off 'what if...' worries
Limiting choices and actions due to Self-doubt and catastrophic worries(such as avoiding new challenges and food-related socializing)
outcomes: Experiencing diminished autonomy and a sense of being trapped

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Excessive Self-doubt when trying to build new relationships,believing oneself not good enough and thus Withdrawal
Leading with Self-denial when facing new challenges,being overly cautious

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: 'I try to tough it out alone',unwilling to actively seek support
Turns the energy for coping with stress toward self-criticism and self-control (strict dietary control)

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: Bypasses direct experience of fear through extensive online research and theorizing
In food-related social situations, chooses avoidance rather than facing and coordinating

positive_force: Able to distinguish logic from emotion,with some rational evaluation ability(admitting that not every unhealthy meal leads to illness)
Willing to seek help and start counseling
Has initial motivation and willingness to change (willing to try a more balanced perspective and small-step actions)
Has basic social support (one close friend)
negative_force: Marked Self-denial(equating one failure with global powerlessness)
Catastrophizing and future-predicting thinking leading to health Anxiety
Black-or-white cognitive patterns worsen self-esteem problems
Excessive research and dietary control,maintaining the Anxiety cycle
Avoids food-related socializing; sleep and motivation affected

target_behavior.behavior: Intense health-catastrophizing Anxiety and avoidance when consuming high-calorie foods
antecedent: Eating pizza or other high-calorie foods
target_behavior.core_reason: Linking unhealthy diet with the inevitable outcome of serious illness and painful Death,forming catastrophic cognition out of worry about being unable to afford treatment
target_behavior.function: Escaping perceived danger and gaining a sense of control(through strict dietary control,excessive research,Avoids socializing)
target_behavior.consequence: Work attention and Decreased efficiency,Sleep affected,Avoids socializing,lowered overall quality of life

target_behavior.behavior: Self-denial and Anticipation of failure when facing new challenges(accompanied by Anxiety and Withdrawal)
antecedent: After failing at trying Learning a new skill
Every time facing new challenges or learning tasks
target_behavior.core_reason: Overgeneralization and black-and-white beliefs('failure = I am not smart/will never learn') leading to Impaired self-esteem and lowered Self-efficacy
target_behavior.function: Avoids failure and shame, maintaining surface security
target_behavior.consequence: Doubting one's own abilities across domains,career and Academic performance affected,difficulty starting new relationships and opportunities
